persona: Vehicle test engineer at a Tier-1 supplier moving into ADAS application engineering
resumeText:
Arjun Nair | Bengaluru | arjun.nair@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Vehicle Test Engineer - ADAS, Nandi Mobility Engineering, Bengaluru (2019 - present)
- Validated adaptive cruise control and automatic emergency braking on test vehicles at the proving ground.
- Tuned ACC following-distance parameters on vehicles using ETAS INCA calibration datasets.
- Logged CAN and CAN-FD traffic from front radar and camera ECUs during test drives.
- Analysed vehicle network traces in Vector CANoe to find missing radar object messages.
- Wrote Python scripts to extract braking events from drive logs and build weekly reports.
- Raised and tracked drive-test issues in Jira with logs attached.

Graduate Engineer Trainee, Nandi Mobility Engineering, Bengaluru (2018 - 2019)
- Supported chassis dynamometer testing.

SKILLS
MATLAB, Simulink, CANoe, INCA, Python

EDUCATION
BE Automobile Engineering, MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology, 2018
